population.condition: type 2 diabetes mellitus inadequately controlled with metformin in a predominantly Chinese population
key_inclusion_criteria: Adults aged ≥18 years, or ≥20 years in Taiwan
Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus ≥60 days before screening
Stable metformin dose of ≥1500 mg or the maximum tolerated dose for ≥60 days before screening
evidence: Eligibility criteria included age ≥18 years (≥20 years in Taiwan), type 2 diabetes diagnosed ≥60 days before screening, HbA1c 53–91 mmol/mol, and stable metformin treatment for ≥60 days. fileciteturn18file0
The overall population had a mean age of 53 years; 58.3% (n=840) were male. The overall female percentage was not explicitly reported. fileciteturn18file0

outcomes.name: Change in HbA1c from baseline to week 26
outcomes.comparison: oral semaglutide 3 mg vs sitagliptin 100 mg
evidence: The primary endpoint was change in HbA1c from baseline to week 26. The estimated treatment difference for oral semaglutide 3 mg versus sitagliptin 100 mg was −2 mmol/mol (95% CI −4, −1; p<0.01) for the trial product estimand. fileciteturn18file0
